final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.telescref AS t, o.weathprofile AS w, AVG(s.modindex) AS am, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS ap FROM signals s JOIN telescopes te ON te.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = te.observstation GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(am) AS bm FROM s1) SELECT s1.w AS weather, AVG(s1.am) AS avg_mod, AVG(s1.ap) AS avg_phase, AVG(s1.am - s2.bm) AS avg_diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.bm IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.am > s2.bm GROUP BY s1.w
